project_name: Applied Digital Toronto AI Data Center
status_detail: Applied Digital presented a potential AI data center east of Toronto to Deuel County commissioners in April 2025; later reporting says the company said the project is unlikely to go forward and would let the land agreement lapse after South Dakota rejected data-center tax incentives.
notes: County homepage verified; local radio/news and data-center trade press give the project details: 150-200 acres east of Toronto, two approximately 907,500 sq ft buildings, 400-430 MW total load, $4.3B-$5.5B Applied/customer investment and up to $10B-$16B total impact. No final local approval found; current status treated as rejected/canceled due to reported lapse/withdrawal.

status_detail: Grant County is actively considering data-center zoning standards, but no project application/developer/site was found.
notes: County homepage and Planning & Zoning page list Public Comments on Data Centers, Notice of Public Hearing Ordinance 2026-01, and Data Center Amendment Ordinance 2026-01. The ordinance text defines and regulates data processing centers over 10 MW IT load, including siting, utility verification, noise, water, monitoring and emergency plans. This is policy readiness, not evidence of a named project.
